name: persona-lab
description: You ship UI and product decisions without knowing how different users will react, and real research is too slow to run on every change. Persona Lab assembles a task-specific panel of distinct AI personas, always including an adversarial lens, runs each pass independently to avoid groupthink, and saves the personas to a recallable library. You get structured, evidence-labelled reactions in minutes, as a hypothesis to review rather than validated user research. Start with /persona-lab:persona-review.

interface.shortDescription: Launch task-specific persona panels for UI, product, and workflow review.
